name: spacefrontiers
description: Full-text retrieval over peer-reviewed papers, books, patents, Wikipedia, Reddit, Telegram, and YouTube. Four read-only tools return canonical source URIs for citation.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http spacefrontiers https://mcp.spacefrontiers.org

tools.name: spacefrontiers_search_documents
tools.description: Search peer-reviewed papers, books, patents, and Wikipedia. Use for citations and prior art.

tools.name: spacefrontiers_search_social
tools.description: Search Reddit, Telegram channels, and YouTube transcripts. Use for news and community discussion.

tools.name: spacefrontiers_fetch_document
tools.description: Retrieve full text + references for one document by canonical URI (DOI, arXiv, ISBN, PMID, ...).

tools.name: spacefrontiers_search_in_document
tools.description: Find passages within one document by text query. Use for documents over ~20K tokens.
